claims.claim: Salesforce completed its acquisition of Informatica on November 18, 2025; Informatica now operates as Informatica from Salesforce rather than as an independent public issuer.

Informatica continues to ship and integrate enterprise data-management capabilities inside the Salesforce ecosystem, including 2026 Google Cloud and Databricks integrations, so the operating capability persists even though independent-equity underwriting requires identity/tradability revalidation.

risks.risk: INFQ may no longer be a valid independently tradable equity candidate after acquisition close; Alpha/Core must revalidate entity/tradability before numeric underwriting.

contradictions.contradiction: Current workgraph still routes INFQ as an independent ticker while primary-source acquisition-close evidence says Informatica is part of Salesforce.

unknowns.unknown: Whether Earth Core already has a separate deterministic corporate-action path pending that will retire/replace INFQ.
